text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Okay... This time for sure! I can't call
m'self a city girl if someth'n like
this throws
me for a loop!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't you two hang out
together?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You could... take your trainer shopping or
maybe go out to eat! You
know, a little
city girl lunch date.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A d-d-d-d-d-DATE?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-b-but, aren't d-dates... usually done
b'tween two people who
l-l-like each
other a lot?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yukino... Not that kind of date. It's just a little outing between frien—uh, earth to Yukino? Hello?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(So in order to be a real city girl...
I need
t'go on a date with my
trainer?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
U-um, excuse me! I-I was wonder'n if
t'morrow, you'd... you'd... um...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: N-never mind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Sigh... Another invitation down the drain... How many times've I failed now? My nerves keep gett'n in the way...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This exact situation has been repeating
for several days now. Yukino
Bijin will appear
with fire in her eyes, only to deflate in
moments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear she wants to talk, but perhaps
the setting isn't right.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Why was I the one t'be asked out?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(They probably just wanna cheer me up,
but if this goes on any
longer...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...No, that's enough of that! They asked
me to hang out, so I oughta
do my best to
have a roar'n good time, just like a real
city girl!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No...
but I throw a real mean snowball! You
just hafta lock eyes with
the target and
grip the snowball reeeally tight!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! R-right. E-ehehe... Well, I'm a li'l
nervous, but I think I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why can't I hit it?! W-well, I mean, I
did hit a target, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm just glad nobody got hurt... Urgh,
sorry for caus'n such a ruckus...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her shoulders appear tense, perhaps from
nerves. That certainly
would make
throwing darts hard...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-okay...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Ohhh... fiddlesticks. I'm try'n to thank
you, but I just ended up caus'n
more
problems...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (All righty, Yukino Bijin, you're up! Let's order for the both of us, and do it with style.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(The name's a bit long, but I'm sure I can
say it easy-peasy!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait! I'll order for us! We'll have...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Two Howdy-do Dragonfood Smoothies!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Nooo! That's not the right name!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
U-um... Could you just... f'rget that
happened?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Gah! And now I'm being comforted too?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...What now? No matter what I do...
I keep
screw'n up...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the lipstick City's been
advertis'n.
Look at all these shades...
Golly...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(They're really spiffy,
but... I shouldn't buy
one till I'm closer t'being a
real city girl.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, n-no, I'm just look'n! Besides,
I'm... not
ready for this city girl
lipstick yet.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't even invite my trainer on a
date... No way I'm pull'n off
makeup like
this...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Not so long as I trail behind the real
city
girls...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's head hangs low, as if in
shame.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A day of fun should've been just what she
needed, but it seems even
that's not
enough to ease her worries.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her demeanor feels closed off... At this
rate, her mood's never going
to improve.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's ears perk up, and her eyes
begin to sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-truly?! W-well, golly... That's just
jim-dandy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Today didn't go 'xactly as planned,
but if
Trainer's happy, then who
cares!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mighta screwed up... but so long as they
had a ball, I'm pleased as
punch! There's
always next time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I had fun too! Thank you so much for
today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(And don't you worry, Trainer! I'm gonna
get better at this dat'n thing,
if it's the last
thing I do!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Sure, we might've hit a few bumps this
time 'round, but at the very
least, I should
be able t'invite you out m'self!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her smile grows bigger and bigger, I
breathe a small sigh of relief.
